summary.text: George E. "Chip" Campsen III is a Republican from Charleston who represents Senate District 43 (Beaufort, Charleston and Colleton Counties) in the South Carolina Senate, where he has served since 2005 and chairs the Fish, Game and Forestry Committee.

paragraphs.text: Campsen was born March 30, 1959, in Charleston, and graduated from Wando High School in 1977, Furman University (B.S., 1981) and the University of South Carolina (J.D., 1988; M.S., 1989).

His page lists him as a businessman and attorney who was executive vice president and later president of Fort Sumter Tours, Inc. and SpiritLine Cruises, LLC, and who has practiced with the Campsen Law Firm since 2010.
He served in the South Carolina House of Representatives from 1997 to 2002 and was senior policy advisor to Governor Mark Sanford in 2002-03.
In the Senate, in addition to chairing Fish, Game and Forestry, he sits on the Corrections and Penology, Judiciary, Legislative Oversight, Rules and Transportation committees.
